scope.operation: finite analytic-parallel/rational-Bezier intersections whose two authored equations share a genuinely bivariate nullity-one rational parameter component
completed_families: primitive nonlinear rational correspondences between the two authored curve parameters
weakly monotone maps with stationary points that do not reverse sign
full overlap, one-sided partial overlap, and two-sided exact domain clipping
selected-normal branch replay and exact rejection of opposite or vanishing normal branches
projective denominator rootlessness over the actual clipped domain
STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 policy propagation without approximate construction

mathematical_contract.component_model: Hypersolve extracts a primitive nullity-one relation t = N(u)/D(u), or its exact transposed orientation, from the first nonzero subresultant of the two rational bivariate equations
mathematical_contract.coefficient_domain: the extractor accepts exact rational bivariate coefficients; unsupported Real coefficient towers remain explicit uncertainty
mathematical_contract.authorization: Hypercurve accepts the map only after replaying both original authored equations identically on the cleared parameter lift
mathematical_contract.content: Hypersolve cancels exact rational polynomial content shared by the interpolated first-subresultant coefficients before publishing the map
mathematical_contract.domain: Hypercurve proves D is rootless on the retained source interval, proves weak monotonicity interval by interval, intersects the exact image with the other authored [0,1] domain, and constructs oriented parameter ranges without sampling
mathematical_contract.stationary_points: interior derivative roots are permitted only when exact side signs show no reversal; a noninjective map is not guessed into one overlap
mathematical_contract.branch: the selected signed normal equation must be rootless and have the requested sign on the clipped domain; the opposite branch and a vanishing selected branch are rejected
mathematical_contract.poles: a denominator root in the retained domain is an explicit DegenerateResultant boundary until pole-split component transport is implemented
mathematical_contract.endpoints: clipping may retain exact rational endpoints or isolated algebraic endpoints; neither is rounded to a construction coordinate
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT accepts only exact subresultant, identity, rootlessness, sign, monotonicity, and range certificates
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the identical proof graph and can terminate only through inherited Hyperreal 512-bit equality decisions; it does not create an approximate component, range, branch, or contact
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: unsupported higher-nullity, nonmonotone, pole-split, or coefficient-tower cases remain explicit degeneracy rather than being mislabeled NoIntersection

implementation.hypersolve_api: rational_parameter_component_bivariate_polynomial_system returns BivariatePolynomialRationalComponentReport with explicit status, retained orientation, and primitive numerator/denominator coefficients
implementation.extraction_algorithm: specialized exact first-subresultant samples are interpolated directly; the abandoned generic adjugate prototype is not retained
implementation.hypercurve_spine: BezierParallel2::intersection_candidate_system performs cheap component detection, rootless axis saturation, rational component certification, and exact overlap return before the expensive generic resultant route
implementation.fallback: degree-zero through degree-three ordinary pairs skip the speculative early component probe and retain the complete historical resultant-then-degenerate-replay path
implementation.degree_gate: the early shared-component probe is limited to target degree four or greater; this is a performance dispatch gate, not a mathematical limit
implementation.replay: BezierParallel2::replay_rational_parameter_component certifies the component against the retained source differential, distance sign, authored target homogeneous basis, and both original equations
implementation.carrier: candidate equations and certified overlap are stored in a compact enum so one result never allocates both representations
implementation.exact_fixture: P(t)=(3t/8,9t^2/64) with its unit left parallel and target map t=(4u-u^2)/(6-3u) yields primitive component -3tu+6t+u^2-4u; the authored source is non-PH
implementation.tests: the nonlinear fixture covers full, partial, reversed, and two-sided clipping under both policies; private tests cover stationary derivatives, branch signs, authored-equation replay, denominator poles, and both parameter orientations

matched_release_benchmark.method: five sequential direct all-feature release-binary samples per revision pinned to CPU 11 with byte-identical fixtures; build-lock-contaminated and concurrent warmup samples were discarded before this recorded set
matched_release_benchmark.baseline_semantics: the nonlinear component lanes return one unresolved DegenerateResultant marker; the candidate returns one certified Overlap. Equal checksums therefore count result records, not equal mathematical certainty
matched_release_benchmark.noise: the third current process contains a visible system-contention outlier in several lanes; all five samples are retained and medians are reported

warm_ph_overlap_candidates.interpretation: sub-two-microsecond low-iteration sentinel; direction is useful but magnitude is noisy

nonlinear_rational_component_candidates.interpretation: one certified exact overlap replaces one unresolved marker while also completing 2.74 times faster

nonlinear_rational_component_contacts.interpretation: exact authored-equation and selected-branch replay replaces unresolved degeneracy

cold_ph_overlap_contacts.interpretation: early exact rational/PH authority avoids constructing the historical generic resultant on each cold object

ordinary_sentinels.interpretation: the degree-four dispatch gate removes the earlier speculative cost from low-degree ordinary pairs; most retained ordinary lanes improve and the two regressing medians remain within 1.19 percent

matched_heaptrack.method: the identical complete release benchmark process under Heaptrack on CPU 11; both binaries contain the same nonlinear component fixture
matched_heaptrack.interpretation: the early exact component and PH routes avoid the historical generic elimination structures; retained-at-exit bytes are process-wide clone-shared caches reported by Heaptrack and are not asserted to be unreachable leaks

matched_offset_microbenchmark.interpretation: the byte-identical source fixture makes this a linked implementation/Hypersolve delta; the accepted 0.84 percent file growth buys a previously unresolved exact family and large time/heap reductions

static_call_graph.audited_route: BezierParallel2::intersection_candidate_system reaches component detection, rootless-axis reduction, rational_parameter_component_overlap, exact certification, and replay; Hypersolve's direct first-subresultant API and its orientation tests are present in the same selected-stack graph
static_call_graph.caveat: the utility is a static source approximation and resolves some imported free-function calls under the caller namespace; matched graphs exclude tests and benchmarks, and the selected exact-stack scan deliberately excludes Hypermesh

competitive_context.reason: the available peer offset libraries do not expose exact two-parameter projective correspondence, authored-equation identity replay, selected-normal proof, algebraic overlap endpoints, or STRICT/APPROXIMATE_512 evidence
competitive_context.comparison_rule: a heuristic sampled offset or unresolved historical marker is not reported as correctness-equivalent throughput; competitive Boolean and ordinary offset comparisons remain in the broader CurveRegion2 benchmark matrix
